name: Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer
author: davelabs

sections.description:
Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer is the visual folder manager for WordPress. Tame your page and post lists by grouping them into intuitive, smart folders directly in your admin dashboard.

Built for creators, site builders, and agencies, Folderra turns long, messy content lists into a structured, visual workspace. Navigate large sites in seconds and manage your content workflow with ease. Stop wasting time searching. Start organizing like a pro.

📺 Video Tutorial

Learn how to organize your WordPress content with Folderra in just a few minutes.

🚀 Key Features

  • Visual Folder Manager: Create unlimited folders for pages and posts.
  • Simple Drag & Drop: Organize content visually—no complicated settings.
  • Mixed-Content Folders: Group pages and posts together in the same folder.
  • Clean Admin UI: A streamlined interface that feels native to WordPress.
  • Full Control: Rename, reorder, duplicate, or delete folders in a click.
  • 100% Admin-Only: Works only in your dashboard—no front-end changes or performance impact.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Site Managers who need to organize dozens or hundreds of pages.
  • Bloggers wanting to group posts by series, topic, or stage of creation.
  • Agencies that require a clean, client-friendly admin structure.
  • Anyone tired of scrolling through the standard WordPress post list.

Why Folderra?

  • 🧩 Keep your WordPress admin structured and easy to browse
  • ⚡ Save time by grouping content logically
  • 🧭 Navigate large sites more efficiently
  • 🖱️ Manage everything visually — no learning curve
  • 🔒 100% safe: no front-end impact, no data overwritten

Folderra works entirely inside the WordPress dashboard.
Looking for more power? Advanced templates, funnel builders, and A/B testing are available in Folderra PRO – Funnel & Conversion Suite.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, transmit, or share personal data.
All folder data is stored locally in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer.
  3. Go to WP Admin → Smart Folder to start organizing your content.
sections.faq:
What is a smart folder?

A smart folder is a visual container inside your WordPress admin. It lets you group pages and posts together for easier access, without changing their categories, tags, or URLs.

Does this change my categories, taxonomies, or permalinks?

No. Smart folders are an admin-only organizational layer.
Your categories, taxonomies, and URLs remain unchanged.

What content types are supported?

Pages and Posts in the free version.
Additional content types may be supported by third-party add-ons or via Folderra PRO.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No. Folderra runs only in the admin area and does not add front-end scripts or styles.

Is my content safe?

Yes. The plugin never modifies or deletes your original posts or pages.
It only manages folder relationships stored safely in your database.

1.1.0

  • Improved admin UI and overall user experience
  • Enhanced folder management layout and interactions
  • Improved loading states and visual feedback
  • Better mobile usability in folder details
  • Minor performance and UX refinements

1.0.2

  • Improved: Folder Details UI with a cleaner, unified information bar.
  • Improved: Items-per-page selector integrated into the folder info bar for better UX.
  • Improved: Folder type filter now includes Dynamic Templates when available.
  • Fixed: Incorrect “Mixed Content” label shown for dynamic folders.
  • Fixed: Duplicate pagination controls causing layout issues.
  • Fixed: HTML markup cleanup on folder details page.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: removed duplicate Smart Folders panel in the Block Editor (Gutenberg).
  • Fixed: prevented the default WordPress taxonomy meta box from appearing (Classic Editor).
  • Fixed: folder details page no longer breaks after cache cleanup in some setups.
  • Added: embedded video tutorial in the Folderra dashboard.

1.0

  • Folders Plugin Released.
